{"findings":[{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D12","page":1,"quote":"⌀ 16 H7 (+0.018/0)"},{"kind":"title_block","ref":"surface_treatment","page":1,"quote":"I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"The ⌀16 H7 bore (D12) has a tolerance band of 0.018 mm and the part is zinc plated, but no allowance or note accounts for plating buildup on this tight fit. After plating the hole will be undersize, preventing assembly with the mating shaft; the designer should either open the pre-plate machining limits to compensate for coating thickness or add a note to mask/rework the bore after plating."
  , "recommended_correction": "Specify pre-plate machining limits that account for the plating thickness on the H7 bore, or add a note requiring masking or post-plate rework of the ⌀16 H7 hole."}]}
